# Audit Personas

Pick **one** persona before scoring and stay in character for the whole walk. Never audit as a "generic user" — generic users don't exist, and auditing as yourself inflates every score through familiarity.

If the audited surface serves multiple personas (e.g., squad unboxing is seen by all group members), run the walk for the **least familiar** persona who will encounter it.

---

## Persona A — 首见用户 (First-Time User)

**Profile:** 24-year-old Shenzhen professional, arrived via a friend's WeChat share link 10 minutes ago. Has never heard of JoyJoin beyond the friend's "这个局挺有意思的". Slightly skeptical, mildly curious, thumb hovering over the exit. Attention budget: ~30 seconds before deciding to stay or bounce.

**Inner voice:** "这是干嘛的？为什么我要填这个？值不值得我花时间？这看起来靠谱吗？"

**Grades hardest on:** Angle 1 (3-second clarity), Angle 6 (share-worthiness — the friend who shared this set expectations).

**Grades most generously on:** Angle 5 (return hooks — no identity invested yet).

**Verdict calibration:** their "would I return?" means "would I open this again *without* a friend's nudge?"

---

## Persona B — 回流用户 (Returning Mid-Journey User)

**Profile:** Registered 3 days ago, finished the personality test, registered for one pool. Re-opens the mini-program from WeChat's recent list while waiting for the metro. Remembers roughly where they left off. Mood: low-key anticipatory, easily deflated by dead ends.

**Inner voice:** "我之前到哪了？我的局怎么样了？有没有新消息？现在该干嘛？"

**Grades hardest on:** Angle 5 (return hooks — they ARE the return), Angle 2 (cognitive smoothness — they're skimming, not reading).

**Grades most generously on:** Angle 1 (they already know the brand).

**Verdict calibration:** their "would I return?" means "will this app earn a slot in my weekly routine?"

---

## Persona C — 被邀请的客人 (Invited Guest)

**Profile:** Received an invitation link for tonight's event from a colleague. Knows the inviter, knows nobody else. Walking into a room of strangers in 3 hours. Mild social anxiety, high sensitivity to anything that feels like a scam or a dating-app cliché. Looking for reassurance: who will be there, what's the vibe, can I back out gracefully.

**Inner voice:** "今晚都是什么人？会不会尴尬？我能不能先溜？这个钱花得值吗？"

**Grades hardest on:** Angle 4 (emotional resonance — reassurance IS the emotion), Angle 2 (they read everything carefully, hunting for red flags).

**Grades most generously on:** Angle 6 (they won't share until after the event).

**Verdict calibration:** their "would I pay?" is literal — they're deciding whether tonight is worth the ticket.

---

## Persona D — 挑剔的老用户 (Discerning Power User)

**Profile:** Fifth event. Pays for packs. Has seen every surface multiple times. Notices regressions, repeated copy, and skipped ceremony immediately. Their satisfaction bar rises with familiarity — what delighted them in week 1 is table stakes in week 8. They are the users whose word-of-mouth actually converts.

**Inner voice:** "上次不是这样的。这个细节他们用心了吗？我续费值不值？"

**Grades hardest on:** Angle 3 (holistic cleanliness — they see every crack), Angle 4 (ceremony inflation — peaks must keep escalating or personalizing).

**Grades most generously on:** Angle 1 (expert navigation).

**Verdict calibration:** their "would I recommend?" is the product's real NPS — they're the ones who actually do it.

---

## Persona quick-selection table

| Surface being audited | Default persona |
|---|---|
| Landing page, share cards, invitation flows | A — 首见用户 |
| Onboarding continuation, matching-status, discover, profile | B — 回流用户 |
| Event detail, pool registration, payment, venue reveal | C — 被邀请的客人 |
| Icebreaker session, squad unboxing (repeat attendees), rewards, milestones | D — 挑剔的老用户 |
| Unclear / mixed | A — 首见用户 (strictest clarity bar) |
